paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Base LLaMA-3.1-8B & Mistral-7B-v0.3 in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This chart compares the win rates of empathetic responses from four different models: GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral. The chart has four slices, representing the win rates of GPT-4o (two slices, colored blue, 96.8% and 98.4%), LLaMA (colored light blue, 3.2%), and Mistral (colored grey, 1.2%). A legend is not present, but percentage labels are provided inside or next to each slice. The segments appear to be ordered by size, with the largest slices representing GPT-4o, followed by LLaMA and then Mistral. No slices are visually emphasized beyond their relative sizes. The inner circle indicates the win rate percentage.
